---
title: "Alpha diversity — healthy corals"
author: "Joana Krause"
date: "2026-08-13"
output: html_document
---

Alpha diversity (Shannon index) for healthy corals only, broken down by coral family,
complexa/robusta clade, LME (Large Marine Ecosystem), and generic ocean region.
Pairwise Wilcoxon tests with Benjamini-Hochberg correction.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r load-libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(phyloseq)
library(microbiome)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)
library(viridis)
library(tidyr)
library(plyr)    # must be loaded before dplyr to avoid masking conflicts
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
```

# Load phyloseq object

```{r load-ps}
ps_plas_V3_V4 <- readRDS("../data/ps_final.rds")
```

# Alpha diversity — general steps (healthy corals only)

```{r alpha-prep}
ps_healthy <- subset_samples(ps_plas_V3_V4, coral_health == "healthy")

# Remove taxa with zero counts
ps_nonzero <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_healthy) > 0, ps_healthy)

# Calculate Shannon diversity
df_shannon <- microbiome::alpha(ps_nonzero, index = "shannon")
kable(head(df_shannon))

# Add Shannon values to sample metadata
df_metadata         <- meta(ps_nonzero)
df_metadata$Shannon <- as.numeric(df_shannon$diversity_shannon)
kable(head(df_metadata))
```

# FAMILY

### Normality diagnostics

```{r normality-family}
# Families with n < 3 cannot be tested — tryCatch skips them instead of stopping
shapiro_family <- lapply(
  split(df_metadata$Shannon, df_metadata$family),
  function(x) tryCatch(shapiro.test(x), error = function(e) e)
)
shapiro_family
```

```{r normality-plots-family}
dir.create("../output/alpha_div", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

p_hist <- ggplot(df_metadata, aes(x = Shannon, fill = family)) +
  geom_histogram(color = "black", bins = 20, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ family, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = "Histogram of Shannon diversity", x = "Shannon Index", y = "Frequency")

p_qq <- ggplot(df_metadata, aes(sample = Shannon, color = family)) +
  stat_qq() + stat_qq_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ family, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = "Q-Q Plots for Shannon values",
       x = "Theoretical Quantiles", y = "Sample Quantiles")

p_normality <- p_hist / p_qq
ggsave(
  "../output/alpha_div/Shannon_Normality_Diagnostics_healthy_family.pdf",
  p_normality, width = 8, height = 10
)
```

### Pairwise Wilcoxon tests (BH-adjusted)

```{r pval-family}
labels_family <- c(
  "Astrocoeniidae", "Siderastreidae", "Agariciidae", "Euphylliidae", "Acroporidae",
  "Poritidae", "Dendrophylliidae", "Pocilloporidae", "Meandrinidae", "Cladocoridae",
  "Rhizangiidae", "Fungiidae", "Diploastreidae", "Montastraeidae", "Lobophylliidae",
  "Mussidae", "Merulinidae", "Antipathidae", "Briareidae", "Clavulariidae",
  "Alcyoniidae", "Xeniidae", "Plexauridae", "Isididae", "Gorgoniidae"
)
df_metadata$family <- factor(df_metadata$family, levels = labels_family)

# Use only families actually present in the data (droplevels removes empty levels)
observed_families <- levels(droplevels(df_metadata$family))
pairs_family      <- combn(observed_families, 2, simplify = FALSE)

pval_table <- lapply(pairs_family, function(pair) {
  sub <- df_metadata %>%
    filter(family %in% pair) %>%
    mutate(family = droplevels(family))   # ensure exactly 2 levels for wilcox.test
  # Skip pairs where either group has fewer than 2 observations
  counts <- table(sub$family)
  if (any(counts < 2)) {
    return(data.frame(Group1 = pair[1], Group2 = pair[2], P_value = NA_real_))
  }
  res <- tryCatch(
    wilcox.test(Shannon ~ family, data = sub),
    error = function(e) list(p.value = NA_real_)
  )
  data.frame(Group1 = pair[1], Group2 = pair[2], P_value = res$p.value)
}) %>% bind_rows()

pval_table$P_adjusted <- p.adjust(pval_table$P_value, method = "BH")
pval_table$Significance <- cut(
  pval_table$P_adjusted,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, Inf),
  labels = c("***", "**", "*", ".", "ns"),
  right  = FALSE
)

pval_out            <- pval_table
pval_out$P_value    <- format(pval_table$P_value,    scientific = FALSE, digits = 4)
pval_out$P_adjusted <- format(pval_table$P_adjusted, scientific = FALSE, digits = 4)
print(pval_out)

write.csv(
  pval_out,
  "../output/alpha_div/pval_table_healthy_family.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

### Boxplot

```{r plot-family}
custom_colors_clade <- c(
  "complexa"    = "#9c119c",
  "robusta"     = "#a2cd5a",
  "black coral" = "#525252",
  "octocoral"   = "#ffb90f"
)

# Counts displayed in x-axis labels
family_counts <- table(df_metadata$family)
family_labels <- setNames(
  paste0(names(family_counts), " (n=", family_counts, ")"),
  names(family_counts)
)

# Set clade factor order for legend
df_metadata$complexa_robusta <- factor(df_metadata$complexa_robusta,
                                       levels = c("complexa", "robusta",
                                                  "black coral", "octocoral"))

plot_family <- ggboxplot(
  df_metadata,
  x    = "family",
  y    = "Shannon",
  fill = "complexa_robusta"
) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors_clade) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = family_labels) +
  labs(x = "Coral family", y = "Shannon diversity index") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = NULL)) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 11, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin     = margin(t = 2, r = 5, b = 10, l = 15, unit = "mm")
  )

print(plot_family)

pdf(
  "../output/alpha_div/alpha_family_healthy.pdf",
  width = 11, height = 6
)
print(plot_family)
dev.off()

# Summary table
shannon_summary_family <- df_metadata %>%
  group_by(family) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n            = sum(!is.na(Shannon)),
    mean_Shannon = mean(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_Shannon   = sd(Shannon,   na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

shannon_summary_family %>%
  mutate(mean_sd = sprintf("%.3f +/- %.3f", mean_Shannon, sd_Shannon)) %>%
  select(family, n, mean_sd)

write.csv(
  shannon_summary_family,
  "../output/alpha_div/shannon_summary_healthy_family.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

### Pairwise Wilcoxon tests (BH-adjusted)

```{r pval-complexa-robusta}
labels_clade <- c("complexa", "robusta", "black coral", "octocoral")
df_metadata$complexa_robusta <- factor(df_metadata$complexa_robusta,
                                       levels = labels_clade)

# Use only clades actually present in the data
observed_clades <- levels(droplevels(df_metadata$complexa_robusta))
pairs_clade     <- combn(observed_clades, 2, simplify = FALSE)

pval_table <- lapply(pairs_clade, function(pair) {
  sub <- df_metadata %>%
    filter(complexa_robusta %in% pair) %>%
    mutate(complexa_robusta = droplevels(complexa_robusta))
  counts <- table(sub$complexa_robusta)
  if (any(counts < 2)) {
    return(data.frame(Group1 = pair[1], Group2 = pair[2], P_value = NA_real_))
  }
  res <- tryCatch(
    wilcox.test(Shannon ~ complexa_robusta, data = sub),
    error = function(e) list(p.value = NA_real_)
  )
  data.frame(Group1 = pair[1], Group2 = pair[2], P_value = res$p.value)
}) %>% bind_rows()

pval_table$P_adjusted <- p.adjust(pval_table$P_value, method = "BH")
pval_table$Significance <- cut(
  pval_table$P_adjusted,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, Inf),
  labels = c("***", "**", "*", ".", "ns"),
  right  = FALSE
)

# Data frame of BH-significant pairs for stat_pvalue_manual
# (uses the pre-computed BH-adjusted stars directly, not ggpubr's internal test)
signif_df_clade <- pval_table %>%
  filter(P_adjusted < 0.05) %>%
  transmute(
    group1   = as.character(Group1),
    group2   = as.character(Group2),
    p.signif = as.character(Significance)
  )

pval_out            <- pval_table
pval_out$P_value    <- format(pval_table$P_value,    scientific = FALSE, digits = 4)
pval_out$P_adjusted <- format(pval_table$P_adjusted, scientific = FALSE, digits = 4)
print(pval_out)

write.csv(
  pval_out,
  "../output/alpha_div/pval_table_healthy_complexa_robusta.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

### Boxplot

```{r plot-complexa-robusta}

  "octocoral"   = "#ffb90f"
)

complexa_robusta_counts <- table(df_metadata$complexa_robusta)
complexa_robusta_labels <- setNames(
  paste0(names(complexa_robusta_counts), "\n(n=", complexa_robusta_counts, ")"),
  names(complexa_robusta_counts)
)

plot_complexa_robusta <- ggboxplot(

  x    = "complexa_robusta",

if (nrow(signif_df_clade) > 0) {
  max_y <- max(df_metadata$Shannon, na.rm = TRUE)
  signif_df_clade$y.position <- max_y * 1.05 +
    (seq_len(nrow(signif_df_clade)) - 1) * max_y * 0.08
  plot_complexa_robusta <- plot_complexa_robusta +
    stat_pvalue_manual(
      signif_df_clade,
      label = "p.signif"   # BH-adjusted stars from pval_table$Significance
    )
}

print(plot_complexa_robusta)

    .groups = "drop"

shannon_summary_clade %>%
  mutate(mean_sd = sprintf("%.3f +/- %.3f", mean_Shannon, sd_Shannon)) %>%
  select(complexa_robusta, n, mean_sd)

write.csv(
  shannon_summary_clade,
  "../output/alpha_div/shannon_summary_healthy_complexa_robusta.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

### Pairwise Wilcoxon tests (BH-adjusted)

```{r pval-lme}
labels_lme <- c(
  "Insular Pacific-Hawaiian",
  "Pacific Central-American Coastal",
  "Gulf of Mexico",
  "Caribbean Sea",
  "Southeast U.S. Continental Shelf",
  "Northeast U.S. Continental Shelf",
  "Bermuda",
  "Mediterranean Sea",
  "Red Sea",
  "Arabian Sea",
  "South China Sea",
  "West Central Australian Shelf",
  "Northwest Australian Shelf",
  "Indonesian Sea",
  "Micronesia",
  "Melanesia",
  "Northeast Australian Shelf",
  "Polynesia"
)
df_metadata$geo_loc_lme <- factor(df_metadata$geo_loc_lme, levels = labels_lme)

# Use only LMEs actually present in the data
observed_lme <- levels(droplevels(df_metadata$geo_loc_lme))
pairs_lme    <- combn(observed_lme, 2, simplify = FALSE)

  counts <- table(sub$geo_loc_lme)
  if (any(counts < 2)) {
    return(data.frame(Group1 = pair[1], Group2 = pair[2], P_value = NA_real_))
  }
  res <- tryCatch(
    wilcox.test(Shannon ~ geo_loc_lme, data = sub),
    error = function(e) list(p.value = NA_real_)
  )
  data.frame(Group1 = pair[1], Group2 = pair[2], P_value = res$p.value)
}) %>% bind_rows()

pval_table$P_adjusted <- p.adjust(pval_table$P_value, method = "BH")
pval_table$Significance <- cut(
  pval_table$P_adjusted,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, Inf),
  labels = c("***", "**", "*", ".", "ns"),
  right  = FALSE
)

pval_out            <- pval_table
pval_out$P_value    <- format(pval_table$P_value,    scientific = FALSE, digits = 4)
pval_out$P_adjusted <- format(pval_table$P_adjusted, scientific = FALSE, digits = 4)
```
